content:
maya: Quick shout — huge props to @samira (eng-sre), @raj (design), and @ethan (platform) for saving the Canary demo this afternoon. Demo looked flawless after the rollback and patch. :raised_hands:

samira: Team effort! Spotted a weird mem leak in the routing layer, pushed hotfix, running sanity tests now. logs showed `TimeoutError: kvcache flush failed` right before the spike.

raj: Tiny UX tweak +2 reduced perceived latency. Nice coordination — felt like clockwork. :sparkles:

ethan: Pushed the fallback policy and rerouted a couple of hosts. Kept tail latency in check. Also @maya you owe the on-call crew coffee. :coffee:

alyssa: I brought a box of donuts to the kitchen — help yourselves while it's warm. :doughnut:

maya: Also ordering pizza for the crew to celebrate — quick poll for toppings: https://polls.example.com/3Abc (please vote)

ops-bot: Incident closed — #INC-4021 — root cause: failed graceful fallback. Duration: 18m. Autoretry tallies: 3.

samira: I’ll draft a short blurb for #postmortems later tonight with timeline and next steps.

maya: Perfect, thanks. For now, huge thanks again everyone — honestly saved the demo and a customer's demo slot. :heart:

ethan: GIF: https://giphy.com/saved-demo (for the celebratory vibes)

raj: +1 :tada: :clap:

maya: tagging CS to keep them in the loop — @lina @josh

lina: Thanks — I’ll update the customer-facing thread and let them know it was mitigated quickly. Big relief.

josh: If anyone’s free tomorrow morning, coffee’s on me for the on-call heroes. Drop by the kitchen.

maya: Thank you all again — small, focused cross-team effort with big impact. Appreciate it. :star2:
